semiconductor_relevance: High — Xiamen Maida Intelligence Technology specializes in precision machining tools and equipment specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Xiamen Maida Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures high-precision machine tools and drilling equipment for the semiconductor industry. With a focus on micro-diameter drills and PCD drills for single-crystal silicon processing, the company aims to provide advanced solutions for semiconductor component manufacturing.
capabilities: High-precision micro-machining drills with a minimum diameter of 0.03mm
PCD drills for single-crystal silicon processing

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Xiamen, Fujian Province, and has a history of local manufacturing since 1995.
